56773.characters: Join a pool with your friends, tip its matches, place one forecast per season, and see who comes out on top. Free, no betting, no prizes — only bragging rights.

56805.name: you find every league, cup and tourname
56805.characters: you find every league, cup and tournament Matchowl runs. Tap

56807.name: on the season you want to follow — its
56807.characters: Pools decide what's yours. Every match of the season a pool of yours tips shows up on Home and under My matches, from the day the pool starts counting. You can tip any other match Matchowl covers too: find it under All or on its competition's page, and once tipped it stays among your matches. A tip counts in every pool it applies to.

56816.name: Every match row shows the score board on
56816.characters: Every match row shows the score board on the left and your tip capsule on the right. Tap the capsule to set a score with the steppers; it saves when you close it. Tips lock at kick-off — after that the capsule shows what you had, and once the match is over it turns grey on a miss and stays orange on a hit, with the points next to it.

56817.name: In a knockout match a draw is a draw aft
56817.characters: In a knockout match a draw is a draw after 90 minutes; the small dot on the capsule is your pick for who goes through. In a two-legged tie both legs are tipped like normal matches, and the strip under the row shows the aggregate and who advances.

56823.name: Correct result (home win, draw, away win
56823.characters: Correct result (home win, draw, away win)

56839.name: The parts add up: an exact score collect
56839.characters: The parts add up: an exact score collects all of them. A pool can run its own weights; the match page shows the breakdown of every scored tip.

56858.name: Each season you play has one forecast, p
56858.characters: Each season you play has one forecast, placed before its first match and locked from then on. For a league it is a handful of calls — champion, the European places, relegation. For a tournament it is the full thing: group standings, the bracket, the winner. Forecast points come in as the season resolves, and they count on every board next to your tip points.

56885.characters: When the pool's season is over, the pool is finished: the board stays as history, the chat stays open for a month, and the owner can set the pool up again for the next season with one tap — same members, same settings, fresh invites.

69853.name: Tabs (all variants): Home · Matches · Pools · Friends. Competiti
69853.characters:
Decided (2026-11-23):

Home — A, with Your teams as the sideways strip from B. Live stays below Tip now: pools and challenges come first. A compact Home (B) may come back later as a user setting.

Matches — search is an icon in the header. One single-choice filter row: My matches · All · your country, then pinned competitions, then More. Live is pinned at the right end and narrows whatever is picked. When the filter isn't the default (My matches, Live off), a ✕ clear button is pinned at the left.

Pinning — the More sheet has a Pin toggle on top. In pin mode each competition gets a Pin switch; pinned ones show up as chips in the row. Competitions your pools play are always pinned (marked Pool). Pins are saved on the account.

Tabs — Home · Matches · Pools · Friends.

The frames marked ✓ are the chosen ones; A/B stay for reference.

Not drawn yet: desktop rail, team page, search page, the Pools and Friends tabs.
